support: E8.5-only fitted slope eligibility intersect inherited external field's measured panel, global/non-CM masks and minimum pooled mean 0.02 at either endpoint; never filter by E9.5 test outcome
operator: Keep exact v0094 detection support and positive count; Qnew(q)=Qcarrier(q)+b*(Qparent(q)-Qcarrier(q)) at each parent empirical positive midpoint rank
empty_side: Parent empty remains zero; carrier empty uses parent quantiles and hence no displacement modification
floor: Smallest actually observed positive value of the two parents for that fine-state gene; no synthetic pseudocount
monotone_repair: Stable sort the floor-corrected full positive vector; report negative steps, reordered fraction and rank distances, and max/mean value changes due to sorting
floor_gate: If more than 1% of touched positive values require the observed-positive floor, stop without a target artifact; no threshold retuning
normalization: float64 expm1, row-scale to 10000, log1p, float32
endpoint: b=1 must reproduce exact v0094 before closure and exact v0096 after closure
slope_model: Frozen FITTED_E85_ONLY.npz; slope bounds/shrinkage fixed in affine_assay.json before held-out E9.5 assay
scientific_scope: Source-fitted positive-displacement scale test. Cross-study differences are not identified as pure assay effects, and E9.5 evidence does not establish E14.5 or future transportability
